comment: Overrides for scripts/rust-notices.py. The crates below publish no license text on crates.io; their texts are copied verbatim from the upstream repositories into licenses/rust/. Versions are pinned where the text comes from a release tag, so an upgrade fails the generator until the text is checked again.

crates.name: alloc-stdlib
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; BSD-3-Clause per Cargo.toml. LICENSE copied from github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib at tag 0.2.4, whose alloc-stdlib/Cargo.toml is this version

crates.name: dlopen2
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml. LICENSE copied from github.com/OpenByteDev/dlopen2 (unchanged since 2022, before this release; the repository has no tag for it)

crates.name: siphasher
crates.reason: The crate's COPYING only points to LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE, which 1.0.3 does not publish. Texts copied from github.com/jedisct1/rust-siphash at tag 1.0.4, the first tag that has them; COPYING ships too and carries the copyright lines

crates.name: unic-*
crates.reason: The unic crates publish no license file; MIT/Apache-2.0 per Cargo.toml. LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE copied from github.com/open-i18n/rust-unic at tag v0.9.0, which all of them share

crates.name: objc2*
crates.reason: The objc2 crates (macOS only) publish no license file. objc2, objc2-foundation and objc2-encode are MIT, the others Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT (LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2); MIT chosen for all. LICENSE-MIT.txt copied from that repository, which added it in March 2026 for every crate in it

crates.name: block2
crates.reason: Same repository and terms as objc2 (MIT); macOS only

crates.name: dispatch2
crates.reason: Same repository as objc2; Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT, MIT chosen; macOS only
